Package Server

package Server
  • Classes
    Class
    Description
    DBController
    singleton data-access layer for the GoNature server.
    DBController.NoShowInfo
    snapshot of a single auto-detected no-show, returned by DBController.markNoShowsAndPromote(int).
    DBController.PromotedEntry
    lightweight holder for a promoted (NOTIFIED) waiting-list entry, used by WaitlistTimerService to enforce the 1-hour confirmation window.
    EchoServer
    OCSF server that dispatches incoming Message objects to the appropriate DBController methods and sends back typed response messages.
    EmailService
    sends real notification emails through Gmail's SMTP server (STARTTLS on port 587).
    NoShowService
    periodic sweep that detects visitors who never checked in after their scheduled visit time.
    ReminderService
    background scheduler for reminder and auto-cancellation simulation.
    ServerLauncher
    Plain (non-JavaFX) entry point used as the Main-Class of the runnable server JAR (G9_server.jar).
    ServerUI
    JavaFX application entry point for the GoNature server.
    WaitlistTimerService
    enforces the 1-hour confirmation window for waiting-list promotions.
